items.label: icons — register a tree-shaken icon set
toast — withToast() in provideWr(): global toast defaults
density — withDensity() in provideWr(), plus @use 'ngwr/density' in the global styles: sm / md / lg / touch scale
storage — withStorage() in provideWr(): swappable engine + TTL
theme — withTheme() in provideWr(): a stored light / dark choice lands at boot
loading-bar-router — provideWrLoadingBarRouter(): the loading bar follows navigation

path.description: File that holds the providers array. Defaults to the build target's entry file, or the module it imports that declares one — `src/app/app.config.ts` in an `ng new` app.
